question: Is the build compiler the DOS-extended MSC 6.00AX (CL /EM) rather than real-mode 6.00A? Module 0AD9 (DoAntLions, 1002 bytes) under /AL /Os /Oe /Og /Zd: exact only under 6.00AX; real-mode 6.00A and bound C2L emit 1001 bytes without its global register allocation.

expect.m0AD9@0: mov bx, 0; mov es, word ptr [0x12]; mov word ptr [bp - 0x14], bx
expect.m0AD9@1: !mov bx, 0; mov es, word ptr [0x12]; mov word ptr [bp - 0x14], bx
expect.m0AD9@2: !mov bx, 0; mov es, word ptr [0x12]; mov word ptr [bp - 0x14], bx

expect_contrast_note: 6.00A-only sequence (absent under AX): call 0x3fd; jmp 0x7ab; mov word ptr [bp - 0xe], 0
